notes.title: Graduation of Akira and Makoto Misaki from Go! Go! Nippon! Live With You!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5618082/55315cdad17a77dfa463bfa1227e1e3047e92415.jpg[/img]

It is with great sadness that we must announce the dissolution of the VTuber project Go! Go! Nippon! Live With You!, as well as Akira and Makoto Misaki’s graduation with the intent of resuming their duties as tour guides in Japan.

They will be graduating on Saturday, November 5th, 2022 (PT). More information about the exact time and content of their final graduation livestream(s) will be announced within the coming weeks.

We deeply apologize for the sudden announcement. With restrictions slowly easing for visitors and tourists, Misaki Tours is ready to welcome Travelers back to Japan. As sad as we are to see the sisters go, we are excited for them to take this next step forward in their professional careers. Everyone on the production team and Japan Animation Contents as a whole thank you all for your continued support – together you have helped the Misaki sisters weather these difficult times and we hope that you will visit them one day in Japan!

We want to reassure fans that all existing content on the GGNLive YouTube channel, Twitter account, Discord server, website, and subreddit will remain public. However, the Marshmallow inbox and TikTok account will be terminated immediately following Akira and Makoto’s graduation. YouTube channel memberships will be closed on November 30th, 2022.

Additionally, the aforementioned social media platforms will be utilized for future updates to the Go! Go! Nippon! game franchise by MangaGamer and OVERDRIVE, as progress is slowly being made solely by OVERDRIVE CEO, bamboo. Information relating to these future installment(s) will be made available at a later time.

Thank you to all the fans and Travelers who have supported Akira and Makoto since the project’s debut. We are eternally grateful and we were only able to come this far because of you. We hope you continue to support the Misaki sisters in their activities until their graduation.

notes.title: A Potential New Go! Go! Nippon!?!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6m64Oc1vvb_hpyOLRtxaYg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5618082/a4be1f73dc0bdeb13ece5f0aef4914fdec521082.jpg[/img][/url]
Wednesday night, bamboo—CEO of OVERDRIVE (Deardrops, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418180/MUSICUS/]MUSICUS![/url], and creator of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/251870/Go_Go_Nippon_My_First_Trip_to_Japan/]Go! Go! Nippon![/url])—surprised the Go! Go! Nippon! Live With You! livestream hosts and chat with a sudden, surprise announcement!

In the chat he announced, "When you get 10,000 subscribers, I'll create a new Go! Go! Nippon! game," later adding, "I'll definitely create it," and "Seriously, I'll make it."

After noting that OVERDRIVE will be "fully shut down next year," and that he would take it upon himself to make the new title, Bamboo went on to add in the chat, "I'd like to include voices too if we can."

Bamboo's comments can be found in the live chat replay in their latest livestream VOD: 

[previewyoutube=zxSpmiEOsyg;full]https://youtu.be/zxSpmiEOsyg?t=4469[/previewyoutube]

For those unaware, Go! Go! Nippon! Live With You! is a VTuber project sponsored and produced by visual novel publisher, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/MangaGamer]MangaGamer[/url]. 

Based on the heroines from the visual novel of the same name, the Misaki sisters—Makoto and Akira—have now been regularly live streaming and interacting with fans on YouTube and as a VTuber duo.

You can often find them playing an array of visual novels and games, providing virtual tours of Japan, and even hosting special, exclusive interviews with individuals involved in the visual novel industry!

Fans can subscribe to their [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6m64Oc1vvb_hpyOLRtxaYg]YouTube Channel[/url] to enjoy their content and help realize the goal for a new Go! Go! Nippon!, as well as following them on [url=https://twitter.com/ggnlive_withyou]Twitter[/url] or joining the official [url=http://discord.gg/JNwkwd2GEQ]Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/ggnlive/]subreddit[/url]!

notes.title: Go! Go! Nippon! 2015 Expansion Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Go! Go! Nippon! 2015, an expansion to the original Go! Go! Nippon! is now available on Steam![/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com//app/397030

Go! Go! Nippon! 2015 is a DLC that expands and improves upon the original Go! Go! Nippon! by nearly doubling the story scenario, adding new and improved widescreen HD graphics, as well as e-mote animation for the sprites!

Visit brand-new locations including the Tokyo Skytree, Solamachi, Odaiba, a planetarium and even Comiket! This expansion also adds several new events featuring Makoto and Akira. Enjoy watching Makoto cosplay as a maid at Comiket, attend a Japanese festival with both girls, and now you can even enjoy a late night moment with each of the heroines. There are plenty of new foods to enjoy too, and you can even see some traditional Japanese glass-crafting.

Order yours today and get it 25% off! We hope everyone enjoys all the exciting new moments together with Makoto and Akira!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Go! Go! Nippon! ~My First Trip to Japan~
notes.content:
Go! Go! Nippon! ~My First Trip to Japan~ is Now Available on Steam and is 50% off to celebrate!

As the game's protagonist, you'll travel to famous Japanese sightseeing spots in the company of a pair of beautiful young sisters. The girls will describe the spots, take you out to dinner, and grow closer to you throughout your travels.
